name: 2026-09-03 Meta Muse family release pass
notes: This pass covers every live Muse text model in OpenRouter's Meta catalog on 2026-09-03: Muse Spark 1.1, both Muse Spark 1.2 tiers, Muse Glimmer 30B, and both Muse Spark 1.3 tiers.
The exact canonical snapshots were verified against the live OpenRouter catalog on 2026-09-03.

The complete 2026-08-13 Spark 1.1, Spark 1.2, and Glimmer captures are reinstated unchanged from discarded/2026-08-14-meta-muse-pending-review; their underlying model snapshots still match the live canonical slugs.
Only standard synchronous text-output routes are collected; batch routes and Muse Image are excluded.
Spark routes are pinned to Meta's upstream; Glimmer is pinned to DeepInfra BF16. Fallbacks are disabled throughout.
Collection uses each model's default mandatory reasoning behavior (medium effort).
OpenRouter states that prompts and outputs sent to the Contributor tier may be used to improve Meta's products.
